newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria tenders to buy 26,000 t white/raw sugar.
newsitem.headline: Syria tenders to buy 26,000 t white/raw sugar.

text.p: Syria's General Foreign Trade Organisation for Chemicals and Foostuffs (GEZA) has issued a tender to buy 13,000 tonnes of white sugar and 13,000 tonnes of raws, a GEZA spokesman said on Wednesday.
He said January 15 was set as the final date for offers and that the two amounts should be shipped between February 15 and March 17.
Results of the tender would be made available on January 16, the official said.
Traders said the tender replaces a similar bid for 26,000 tonnes of whites and raws which was issued on December 14.
The tender was cancelled on January 9 due to a mistake in the terms submitted by one potential supplier, they said.
